title: phase-mirror-agent environment configuration (ADR-009 §2.4)
description: Every PHASE_MIRROR_* key the agent understands. This schema is the reference contract; the runtime enforces a matching allow-list in src/security/env.rs (unknown keys in .env abort startup). `x-required-production` marks keys whose absence must abort a production boot (PHASE_MIRROR_ENV=production).

RUST_LOG.description: tracing directive (e.g. info,pirtm=debug). Lower priority than PHASE_MIRROR_LOG_LEVEL.

PHASE_MIRROR_BIND.description: Socket address for the HTTP listener.

PHASE_MIRROR_WS_PORT.description: Port for the operator WebSocket broadcast server.

PHASE_MIRROR_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins ('*' allowed in dev only; rejected in production).

PHASE_MIRROR_TLS_CERT.description: Path to a PEM certificate. Must be paired with PHASE_MIRROR_TLS_KEY.

PHASE_MIRROR_TLS_KEY.description: Path to the PEM private key. Must be paired with PHASE_MIRROR_TLS_CERT.

PHASE_MIRROR_STATE_DIR.description: Directory for durable runtime state (audit WAL, archives).

PHASE_MIRROR_TOOL_CONFIG.description: Path to the tools.toml allow-list/backplane config (ADR-008).

PHASE_MIRROR_TOOL_ALLOW.description: Comma-separated real adapter families to enable (compose,systemd). Empty = simulated only.

PHASE_MIRROR_ENV.description: Deployment environment. Production forces TLS (or explicit PHASE_MIRROR_NO_TLS), a required operator keyring, and disables loopback exemptions.

PHASE_MIRROR_OPERATOR_KEYS.description: Inline operator keys as comma/newline-separated id:scope:secret entries (hashed at load).

PHASE_MIRROR_OPERATOR_KEYS_FILE.description: Operator keys file (0600). Required to exist in production unless PHASE_MIRROR_OPERATOR_KEYS is non-empty.

PHASE_MIRROR_WS_AUTH.description: Require a valid bearer key on WebSocket upgrades.

PHASE_MIRROR_LOOPBACK_EXCEPTION.description: Allow unauthenticated loopback reads (dev convenience; ignored in production).

PHASE_MIRROR_LOG_FORMAT.description: Log output format (ADR-007 §2.1). json for machine-readable.

PHASE_MIRROR_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level read at boot (ADR-007 §2.1).

PHASE_MIRROR_NO_TLS.description: Explicitly allow plain HTTP even in production mode. Only set for loopback/local deployments.

PHASE_MIRROR_MTLS_CA.description: Reserved: mTLS CA bundle for operator clients (not yet wired; kept in the allow-list).
